description: This repo's own config: the shared preset, plus the templates/ directory. Action versions in templates/release.yml and templates/deploy-site.yml are updated here and reach the five tool repos through scripts/sync.sh, which is why the tool repos ignore those two files.

homebrew.description: Formula/*.rb carry the version and four checksums of each release, written by scripts/update.sh from the release's own SHA256SUMS. That script is the single source of truth; a second writer would fight it.
